task: Fix /research WebFetch reroute deadlock by widening the command tool contract and adding a control-plane carve-out

events.content: Widened .claude/commands/research.md allowed-tools so /research keeps a source path and can write its documented outputs when WebFetch is denied
Added two Fallback Rules to .claude/commands/research.md: route github.com through the github skill scripts, and treat a harness permission denial as a capability signal
Added a control-plane carve-out to .claude/skills/research-and-incorporate/SKILL.md and its references/workflow.md
Replaced the raw gh issue create block in references/workflow.md Phase 5 with the github skill new_issue.py script and a --body-file write
Added tests/commands/test_research_command_contract.py covering both the Claude source and the Copilot mirror
Derived the SkillForge mirror skip in scripts/validation/git_hook_policy.py from .claude/commands instead of a hardcoded name list, and removed the duplicate list from lefthook.yml
